name: Doge
look: A close-up photo of a Shiba Inu with golden-tan and cream fur, its head turned toward the camera and its eyes glancing sideways with a wary, skeptical look, in front of a pale background.
use: Short broken-English phrases like such X, very Y, much Z and wow, usually in colorful Comic Sans, are scattered around the dog as its inner monologue about something.
slots: first phrase, like such X (top left)
second phrase, like very Y (top right)
describe: shiba inu dog looking sideways suspiciously
dog side eye with very wow much text around it
fluffy tan dog giving a skeptical sideways glance
close up of a shiba with comic sans phrases around it
japanese dog breed looking at the camera warily
origin: A 2010 photo of a Shiba Inu named Kabosu posted on her owner's blog; the meme spread in 2013.
